third_party_dependencies: vendored SDSL-lite headers (GPL-3.0-or-later and BSD-3-Clause notices retained)
vendored sux headers (GPL-3.0 with runtime exception notices retained)

input_contract.normalization: per-column minimum shift into nonnegative int64 with checked span

output_contract.loss_contract: bit-exact reconstruction of every signed integer
output_contract.model_contract: object-local fit only; no external checkpoint or training corpus

lifecycle_contract.output_bound: checked conservative bound of 128 bytes per input element plus per-column overhead
lifecycle_contract.error_codes: stable tscb_status_v1 with descriptor, capacity, checksum and record validation
lifecycle_contract.reset: ABI reset clears state and native timing while preserving enablement

stream_components.outer_container: 12-byte unique prefix and canonical logical descriptor
stream_components.native_header: variant magic, version, source width, max_bpc, rows and columns
stream_components.column_records: signed bias, payload length, upstream logical size and serialized codec object
stream_components.model_and_index: SDSL serialization contains fitted coefficients, residuals and Elias-Fano/rank support
stream_components.checksum: 64-bit FNV-1a over the complete native frame before the checksum
stream_components.accounting: descriptor, record metadata, serialized model/index payloads and checksum close exactly

upstream_tests.suite: both variants across int8/int16/int32/int64 boundaries, full decode, native random access, corruption, canary and undersized output
same native ABI suite under ASan/UBSan; LSan disabled because managed ptrace is incompatible

known_limitations: Only lossless signed integer VALUE UTS and synchronous MTS are admitted.
Every channel is compressed independently; this is not a joint multivariate model.
The upstream AVX2/AVX-512 paths are excluded; the build disables compiler auto-vectorization and is identified as scalar.
max_bpc is restricted to 16 or 32 and is part of AlgorithmID execution parameters.
Object-local model fitting is included in every compression timing and all serialized model/index bytes are charged; there is no external training split, checkpoint or amortized training cost.
Random access loads the selected serialized column object; bytes_touched reports the complete native frame because checksum validation scans it.
Unsigned integers, floats, nulls, asynchronous MTS, streaming and lossy modes are not admitted.
LeakSanitizer could not run under the managed ptrace environment; ASan and UBSan completed with leak detection disabled.
